metadata.coverage: Pakistan river corridors, major barrages, dams, reservoirs, and monitoring points
metadata.methodology: GIS reference features are separated from observed stations and model forecast points; observed station features do not include fabricated readings.
metadata.source_summary: WaterwayMap/OpenStreetMap river geometry; FFD Lahore public river-state pages; WAPDA/provincial irrigation station network summaries; Open-Meteo GloFAS for modeled discharge hooks.
metadata.map_notice: Demo rendering: river geometry generalized to 0.001 degrees; reference station coordinates unchanged.
metadata.public_live_reading_note: FFD observations and GloFAS forecasts for the river monitoring network are available through the cached river monitoring endpoint.
